description: Traffic Safety is about getting everyone home safely: impaired, distracted and drowsy driving, vehicle safety features and maintenance, traffic laws and what to do after a crash, roads and signs, sharing the road with cyclists, pedestrians and school buses, and promoting traffic safety.
